tensorize_bert_texts: tensorize a batch of text inputs into BERT token tensors with segment labels and positions
numberize_bert_tokens: numberize text or pre-tokenized input into BERT token IDs, segment labels, sequence length, and positions
tokenize_bert_text: tokenize a list of text strings or raw token lists using a TorchScript BERT tokenizer
lookup_bert_token_ids: lookup token IDs from BERT token tuples using the vocabulary with BOS and EOS handling
wrap_bert_numberized_tokens: wrap numberized BERT token IDs by prepending a BOS token for the first sentence segment
